items.title: OnlineCache: Learning Dynamic Caching Policies for Diffusion Inference
items.core_innovation: Adaptive per-sample caching with error correction for diffusion models
items.significance: Moves beyond static caching, cuts latency without quality loss

items.title: DeltaServe: Host-Agnostic Co-Serving of Inference and Fine-Tuning for LLMs
items.core_innovation: Converts idle inference GPU capacity into LoRA fine-tuning throughput
items.significance: Directly improves GPU utilization economics for LLM serving

items.title: WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning
items.core_innovation: Fine-grained per-token dynamic width pruning vs coarse static pruning
items.significance: Better accuracy-efficiency tradeoff for structured LLM sparsity

items.title: BLADE: Boundary-Expanded Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning
items.core_innovation: Detects early-exit points beyond explicit self-doubt cues in CoT
items.significance: Cuts wasted reasoning compute on redundant verification

items.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
items.core_innovation: Trains models to detect and halt beyond-capability reasoning
items.significance: Addresses risk of confident-but-wrong long CoT outputs

items.title: Translation with Thought (TwT): Difficulty-Adaptive Reasoning via RL for MT
items.core_innovation: RL-trained model modulates reasoning depth by task difficulty
items.significance: Generalizable pattern for resource-rational adaptive reasoning

items.title: Learning Latent Reasoning Traces for Scalar Reward Models End-to-End
items.core_innovation: Combines generative reasoning robustness with scalar reward efficiency
items.significance: Could improve RLHF reward model generalization and speed

items.title: Compliance2LoRA: On-Demand Safety Alignment via Hypern
